description: Messages. Homework. Calm. An iPhone app for Scriptable that shows your child's TAMO dienynas, the Lithuanian school e-diary, as one calm page of today's lessons, homework, messages and grades, with a widget and an AI chat about the week.

install.kept: Your sign-in, settings and chat history are kept.
install.firstRun: Open it and sign in with your TAMO username and password.
